dimensions.assessment: Affects landowners in the specified 6,100-acre tract area if they choose to donate or exchange land, and visitors to the park.
dimensions.evidence: acquire approximately 6,100 acres of land or interests in land... by donation or exchange

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts park boundaries and incorporates new land holdings into park administration voluntarily.
dimensions.evidence: administer the acquired land or interests in land as part of the Park

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes land acquisition exclusively through donation or exchange without stating federal appropriations or cash purchases.
dimensions.evidence: by donation or exchange... may not use eminent domain or condemnation

dimensions.assessment: Performs a localized boundary adjustment and park administration change for a single national park.
dimensions.evidence: To adjust the boundary of Big Bend National Park in the State of Texas

dimensions.assessment: Permanently alters the legal boundary of Big Bend National Park upon land acquisition.
dimensions.evidence: revise the boundary of the Park to include the acquired land

missing_information: Valuation or identification of specific private property owners within the target 6,100 acres.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes the acquisition of approximately 6,100 acres by donation or exchange to adjust the boundary of Big Bend National Park in Texas, prohibiting the use of eminent domain.
